title: helm: private values schema, init hooks, and upgrade/rollback validation
author: Maya Patel
description: Add validated values.schema.json and robust init/upgrade/rollback hooks to the redwood-private Helm chart to avoid installer flakiness during on-prem and VPC upgrades. This change introduces a formal JSON Schema for chart values, refactors the init-job templating to be idempotent, and adds pre-upgrade and post-rollback hooks that encapsulate backup and cleanup actions. Motivation: installer failures observed during v0.9->v1.0 upgrades where init jobs re-ran or CRD changes caused partial upgrades (see ENG-1284). The PR includes chart tests for upgrade/rollback paths and migration guidance for deprecated storage.kv.v1 settings. Checklist: add charts/redwood-private/values.schema.json; refactor templates/init-job.yaml; add templates/hooks/pre-upgrade-backup.yaml and templates/hooks/post-rollback-cleanup.yaml; add tests/helm/upgrade-rollback.yaml; update docs/upgrade-notes.md and CHANGELOG. Testing performed: helm lint locally, unit template tests, CI e2e upgrade tests (rerun once due to flakey DB restore step), and manual staging upgrade. Backwards-compatible for most installs; see migration_instructions field for steps when using deprecated keys.
commits: refactor init-job to be idempotent and tolerate partial state
add pre-upgrade backup and post-rollback cleanup hooks
add helm chart tests for upgrade/rollback
docs: upgrade notes and migration steps

release_notes: Helm chart: add values.schema.json validation; idempotent init job; pre-upgrade backup hook; post-rollback cleanup hook; chart tests for upgrade/rollback; migration guidance for deprecated storage.kv.v1
migration_instructions: If you rely on storage.kv.v1, update values to storage.kv.v2 before upgrading. Run helm upgrade --wait on staging and verify pre-upgrade backup job completes. If backup fails, abort upgrade and run the included repair script scripts/ci/restore-backup.sh. See docs/upgrade-notes.md for step-by-step commands.
audit_notes: No new privileged containers. Hooks run as existing service account with conservative RBAC; added explicit permission review in PR. Key management changes limited to optional values.kms.*.
notes_for_backport: Backport to release/1.0 required for customers using managed on-prem installs; minimal conflicts expected in Chart.yaml and values.schema.json.
